QuestInfo.name: The Templar's Sword
QuestInfo.0: #p2081100# says he has something to tell me...
QuestInfo.1: #p2081100# talked about holy power and told me to go to the statue in Orbis Tower. They say I can get this power if I get #b#t4031454##k and place it inside #b#t4031455##k and give it to #b#p2030005##k... I heard the explorer leader, Teng, knows about #t4031454#. I'll go see him first then go to the Cave of Life. \n\n#i4031455##t4031455# #b#c4031455#/1#k
QuestInfo.2: #p2030005# in Orbis Tower gave me holy power!

0.1: To make up for your weakness, you need a new skill. Are you ready to receive it?
0.0: A Knight who completed the 4th job advancement. Your power is certainly strong but you need something more. You are a Paladin, sworn to get rid of darkness. Your power is not perfect. I can't say that you're a perfect Paladin.

yes.0: You're really a knight. I'll let you know how to get a new skill!
yes.1: Do you know there is a spring in the Cave of Life? The water in the spring is not usual water but #b#t4031455##k. You can't touch the holy water so you need to have a container, #b#t4031454##k. Recently, #b#p2060101##k found #t4031454# who sank under the deep sea after being attacked by a giant shark. Go to see him.
yes.2: Put #t4031455# in it. You should not drink it! Put #b#t4031455##k into #b#t4031454##k and sacrifice it to #b#p2030005##k in Orbis tower. If you are a real knight, you will receive a holy power.

no.0: All Paladins want that power. You just aren't ready yet...

1.0: It looks like#p2030005# is looking down on me with merciful eyes.

yes.0: This power is for Templars... Make good use of it please. ..

npc.0: Sacrifice holy water from the Cave of Life in front of #p2030005# in Orbis.
